topic: Three-month emergency fund vs paycheck to paycheck (Asher vs Greta)

scenes.narration: A three month emergency fund cuts the chance of a debt spiral by eighty percent. I am Doctor Dollar. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar holding a clipboard labeled THREE MONTHS, comic burst banner reads EIGHTY PERCENT FEWER DEBT SPIRALS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Asher and Greta each spend three thousand dollars a month on rent, food, and bills and each have a steady job paycheck to paycheck.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, left side man asher at a desk with a budget reading THREE THOUSAND A MONTH, right side woman greta with the same budget, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Asher keeps zero dollars in savings. He puts every leftover dollar into hobbies and trusts that nothing will ever go wrong.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man asher on a couch with hobby gear and concert tickets, comic banner reads NOTHING WILL GO WRONG, empty piggy bank, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Greta builds a nine thousand dollar emergency fund over eighteen months by saving five hundred dollars a month into a high yield account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman greta at a kitchen table with a savings app reading NINE THOUSAND, a small piggy bank with a checkmark, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Asher loses his job for two months. He puts rent and groceries on credit cards and ends the layoff with seven thousand dollars in new debt at twenty four percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked man asher at a kitchen table with credit card statements piling up, comic banner reads SEVEN THOUSAND IN DEBT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Greta uses her emergency fund to cover those same two months, never touches a credit card, and rebuilds the fund within a year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side asher buried in card debt, right side greta with a calmer face and an emergency fund app rebuilding, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Stack three months of bare bones expenses in a high yield savings account. It buys you time, and time is the rarest medicine. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
